constraints: params.x must be a valid TensorFlow tensor.

axis.description: Axis or axes along which the means are computed. The default is to compute the mean of the flattened tensor.
constraints: If provided, must satisfy -rank(params.x) <= axis < rank(params.x)

keepdims.description: If this is set to `True`, the axes which are reduced are left in the result as dimensions with size one.
constraints: If true, the axes which are reduced are left in the result as dimensions with size one.

output.description: Output tensor containing the mean values.
